rule: For a public cell that the operational DB publishes without a sea-area (LME) name: the LME names of the sea points on a 10 x 10 grid inside the cell (OBIS xylookup, shore distance > 0), the same rule the candidate cells use (scripts/build_expansion_cells.py cell_sea_areas, research/expansion-30/cell-sea-areas-2026-10-04.json). A cell-level sea name, not the location of any record.
